basic_profile.bio: Living in a small town in Oregon, I am a 27-year-old tech enthusiast who spends most of my free time gaming and watching tech reviews on YouTube. I work as a freelance web developer, which gives me the flexibility to game late into the night. I am single and often find myself diving deep into games like Destiny and RDR2 to escape the mundanity of daily life. I typically browse Reddit during the late evening hours and am actively involved in discussions on topics related to gaming and technology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having graduated with a degree from a state university. My passion for technology extends to gaming, where I constantly keep up with the latest trends and game releases. I have taught myself web development through online courses and hands-on projects.
